configure_cube_head_defaults: set default CubeHead config including pooler resolution, FC dimensions, and pose type
configure_dataset_thresholds: set dataset truncation, visibility, and min height thresholds for box filtering
configure_loss_weights: set loss weights for 3D, XY, Z, dimensions, pose, and joint losses
configure_solver_and_backbone: set solver type to SGD and DLA backbone type to dla34
configure_virtual_depth_and_pose: set virtual depth focal length, allocentric pose, and chamfer pose options
